scripts.build: pnpm --filter @perflens/analysis-engine build && pnpm --filter @perflens/reporting build && pnpm --filter @perflens/node-instrumentation build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/perflens.js --external:commander --external:@opentelemetry/* && esbuild ../node-instrumentation/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/instrumentation.cjs --external:@opentelemetry/* && esbuild ../node-instrumentation/src/express.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/express-instrumentation.cjs --external:@opentelemetry/* && cp src/preload.cjs dist/preload.cjs && cp ../node-instrumentation/dist/index.d.ts dist/instrumentation.d.ts && sed "s|from './index'|from './instrumentation'|" ../node-instrumentation/dist/express.d.ts > dist/express-instrumentation.d.ts
